caption: First visit: the list is empty and invites adding a task.
"+ New task" opens the New task dialog.
After "Add task" the new task is in the list with its due date.
The list shows an overdue task, a future task and a completed task.
Opening the overdue task shows its details, marked Overdue.
Edit opens the form prefilled with the task's current values.
After Save, the task details show the new title.
Ticking the checkbox marks the task completed.
Unticking it again marks the task incomplete.
The Show, Sort by and Order controls above the list.
Show: Overdue lists only the overdue tasks.
Completing every overdue task leaves none matching Show: Overdue.
Sort by Title, Ascending orders titles case-insensitively.
Submitting with an empty title shows "Title is required".
Save after a conflicting change shows the changed-elsewhere notice with the edit kept.
Opening a task deleted elsewhere shows "This task no longer exists."
Delete asks "Delete this task?" before removing it.
After "Yes, delete" the task is gone from the list.
Reloading the page shows the same tasks as before.
While the list request is in flight: "Loading tasks…".
After the retries fail: the error banner with Retry.
Retry succeeds and the list loads.
